ycy npm open
Open pages on the npm website
Usage:
  ycy npm open [flags]
Commands:
  package-settings	Open npm package settings from the current project or workspace
Flags:
  -h, --help	help for open
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
